# GeoJsonTransform

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Transform a GeoJSON feature with scale, translate, and rotate operations.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/geo-json-transform",
  "type": "GeoJsonTransformOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/geo-json-transform').par.feature` (an input) and `op('/geo-json-transform').out.feature` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.feature`, `out.feature`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `feature` | `GeoJsonField` | `{"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[]}` |
| `scale` | `NumberField` | `1` |
| `translateX` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `translateY` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `rotate` | `NumberField` | `0` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `feature` | `GeoJsonField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
